title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: rejection at registration for a notice out of time
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes when a registered notice is rejected at registration with the reason notice out of time, and which notice window applies to it.

## Rule

1. A notice dated later than the last day of its notice window gives the reason notice out of time.
2. The window is the product's delay loss notice period for delay loss; the product's notice period for apparent loss for any other loss apparent at delivery, when that number is above 0; and the product's notice period for loss not apparent at delivery, for loss not apparent at delivery. All are counted in calendar days.
3. The last day of the window is the cover's delivery date plus those days, counted on calendar dates, and a notice dated on that last day is in time.
4. Loss other than delay loss that was apparent at delivery, under a product whose notice period for apparent loss is 0, has no dated window. Its requirement is the notation on the delivery receipt, which a notice recorded as apparent at delivery carries, so such a notice is never rejected as notice out of time.

## Which window applies

| Kind of loss | Recorded as apparent at delivery | Product's notice period for apparent loss | Window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Delay loss | either | any | Delay loss notice period |
| Any other kind | Yes | above 0 | Notice period for apparent loss |
| Any other kind | Yes | 0 | No dated window; never out of time |
| Any other kind | No | any | Notice period for loss not apparent at delivery |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical window of 5 calendar days)

| Delivery date | Last day | Notice date | Ground applies |
|---|---|---|---|
| 28 December 2025 | 2 January 2026 | 2 January 2026 | No (in time) |
| 28 December 2025 | 2 January 2026 | 3 January 2026 | Yes |
